### 1 — Scene
A small bowl of what appears to be yogurt topped with oat-based cereal or muesli and strawberry pieces. Bright sunlight makes the base somewhat difficult to identify.

### 2 — Vessel
White cereal bowl, approximately **15 cm diameter**.  
Vessel area = 3.14 × 7.5² ≈ **177 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
- Plain-looking yogurt
- Oat-based cereal/muesli
- Strawberries  
No separate oil or sauce is clearly visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
The food occupies approximately **53%** of the bowl’s projected area. Coverage below is apportioned between items without double-counting.

| Item | Coverage | Area | Typical height | Gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Yogurt | 22% | 39 cm² | 2.3 cm | 90 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 90 g | 75 | 68 kcal |
| Cereal/muesli | 18% | 32 cm² | 1.6 cm | 51 ml | 0.4 g/ml | 20 g | 380 | 76 kcal |
| Strawberries | 13% | 23 cm² | 2.0 cm | 46 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 28 g | 32 | 9 kcal |

The cereal density reflects loose flakes, with gaps already accounted for.

### 8 — Sanity check
**About 138 g and 153 kcal** is plausible for this modest mound in a small bowl. The main uncertainties are the depth and type of yogurt and the cereal composition.
